title: Thanksgiving to God the Creator (Jingrwai Ai-nguh U Blei Nongthaw)
cultural_context: Vocal choral hymn giving praise to God for creating the pine mountains, waterfalls, rivers, and seasonal harvests, from 'Ki Jingrwai Ai-nguh Blei'.

khasi: Ai nguh ia U Blei Nongthaw Nongbuh,
Ba la pynlong ia ki lum bad ki wah;
Ki diengkseh ba rben, ki kshaid ba sawa,
Ki kynud ka burom jong U;
U la ai ia ka sngi ban pynshai,
Ia u slap ban pynroi ia ka ri;
To ngin kyntiew la ki sur ba thiang
Ban rwai ia ka nam jong U.
english: Give thanks unto God, the Creator and Sustainer,
Who brought forth the mountains and crystal rivers;
The dense whispering pines, the thundering waterfalls,
All sing forth of His glorious majesty;
He gave the warm sun to illuminate our days,
He poured down the rain to make the valleys fruitful;
Let us lift our voices in sweetest melodies

khasi: Kupar ba kynrei U theh ha ka ri,
Ha ki pynthor, ha ki kper bad ki shnong;
Ki kur ki kha ki ia im suk lang,
Ai ba ka burom kan long sha U Blei,
U Kpa jong u Hynniewtrep baroh;
Haduh ba ka pyrthei kan da wai
Ka nam jong U kan phyrnai.
english: Abundant divine favor He pours upon our land,
Upon paddy fields, fruit orchards, and villages;
Maternal clans and paternal kin dwell in harmony,
Let all majesty and honor belong unto God,
The Father of all the Seven Huts forever;
Until the world itself shall pass away,

vocabulary.nongthaw nongbuh: the Creator and Arranger of the Cosmos
